variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user's selected Talea terracotta hood/book logo with a winking face. Precisely refine this logo so its outer terracotta shape reads MORE LIKE A BOOK rather than a rounded bubble. Preserve the approved facial expression EXACTLY: left small round eye, right small closed upward-bowed eye arch, and the small shallow smile, in existing warm dark brown. Preserve the cream face opening as the integrated negative-space avatar, not a pasted head. Preserve terracotta #CE7055 and brick fold #AF563F, exact lowercase "talea" wordmark in warm dark brown, existing typography, scale, spacing, square white background. One unified logo merging BOOK and HOODED AVATAR. The change should be mostly in the outer page geometry; keep recognisable family resemblance. Remove the small grey "10" from upper left. Clean smooth premium vector-like design, no mockups, no extra text, no grain, no fabric, no realistic 3D. Avoid separate decorative book beneath the face, detailed page lines, floating leaves, extra symbols, heart, flame or video triangle. ONE central logo only. Gentle evolution, about 80 percent of the original silhouette preserved. Replace the bulbous right exterior edge with a more upright book-page edge, softly rounded top and bottom corners, slightly reduce its projection. Refine the left outer edge to a calm nearly straight page edge with rounded corners. Let the upper silhouette gently suggest the sweep of a turned page instead of a drooping bubble: retain the high left curl, raise the upper-right shoulder modestly and give the right page a clean softly squared terminal. Lower edges should suggest two broad page bottoms leading into the central book-binding notch. Preserve the original hood arc surrounding the cream winking face and its sweeping fold. Optionally ONE subtle cream inset edge at the lower-right margin to hint at paper thickness, only if integral and geometrically clean. Result should read as a compact open book with an avatar inside, staying very close to the user's favourite. No tall-vs-short disconnected page lobes.
